sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach have won seven of their ten matches and will be heavy favourites against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season. They then face Cheadle Heath Nomads away on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00), another opportunity to consolidate their league-leading position against a struggling side.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October, a chance to close the one-point gap on leaders Sandbach, while Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local derby. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth are at home to Eccleshall, pitting two strong sides against each other in what could be pivotal in the title race. Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) face Foley Meir at home. In midweek, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October—a fixture for struggling Brereton, who sit 14th and are winless in their last three. The second round of Saturday 10 October matches sees several key contests: Allscott Heath host leaders-to-be Brereton Social; Bilston Town visit Crewe; Stafford Town are at home to Wednesfield Community; Barnton host Dawley Town; Telford Town travel to New Mills; and Alsager Town are at home to Shawbury United, who continue a dire run of six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town welcome Widnes Town, who remain pointless at the bottom of the league.
